title: This is a combined fix for multiple issues, from the changelog:
description:
This is a combined fix for multiple issues, from the changelog:

* Add dracut support in addition to initramfs-tools (LP: #2121951)
* Add workaround to make wireplumber user service wait for camera readiness (LP: #2122049)

Happy to split it up if that would be preferred.

This is very similar to
https://code.launchpad.net/~tobhe/ubuntu/+source/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+git/ubuntu-x1e-settings/+merge/491984
to a point where the wireplumber workaround would conflict.

I also added a conflict with ubuntu-x1e-settings which I proposed the same wireplumber fix for, since those packages are hardware enablement specific they should never be installed at the same time anyway.

@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+
+install() {
+	inst_dir "/lib/firmware"
+	for f in /lib/firmware/qcom/sc8280xp/LENOVO/21BX/* \
+	    /lib/firmware/qcom/a6* ; do
+		inst "${f}"
+	done
+}
+
+# called by dracut
+installkernel() {
+	# Core
+	hostonly='' instmods \
+	    qnoc-sc8280xp \
+	    qcom_hwspinlock \
+	    uio_pdrv_genirq
+
+	# NVME
+	hostonly='' instmods \
+	    phy_qcom_qmp_pcie \
+	    pcie_qcom \
+	    nvme
+
+	# Keyboard
+	hostonly='' instmods \
+	    i2c_qcom_geni \
+	    i2c_hid_of \
+	    hid_generic
+
+	# Display
+	hostonly='' instmods \
+	    pwm_bl \
+	    qrtr \
+	    phy_qcom_edp \
+	    i2c_qcom_geni \
+	    gpio_sbu_mux \
+	    pmic_glink_altmode \
+	    spmi_pmic_arb \
+	    phy_qcom_qmp_combo \
+	    qcom_spmi_pmic \
+	    pinctrl_spmi_gpio \
+	    leds_qcom_lpg \
+	    panel_edp \
+	    msm
+
+	# USB (required for installation from USB)
+	hostonly='' instmods \
+	    qcom_q6v5_pas \
+	    usb_storage \
+	    uas
+}

+[Unit]
+Description=Wait for /dev/media0 and /dev/udmabuf to be available via uaccess
+Conflicts=shutdown.target
+Before=wireplumber.service
+
+[Service]
+Type=oneshot
+ExecStart=/usr/libexec/wp-waitformedia
+RemainAfterExit=yes
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=wireplumber.service
diff --git a/systemd/wp-waitformedia b/systemd/wp-waitformedia
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..7561537
--- /dev/null
+++ b/systemd/wp-waitformedia
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+
+countdown=20
+
+# Return immediately if the camera /dev files don't exist
+if [ ! -e /dev/media0 ] || [ ! -e /dev/udmabuf ]; then
+	exit 0
+fi
+
+# Wait for uaccess to making them user readable
+while [ "$countdown" -gt 0 ]; do
+	if [ -r /dev/media0 ] && [ -r /dev/udmabuf ]; then
+		exit 0
+	fi
+	countdown=$((countdown-1))
+	sleep 0.1
+done
+exit 1
